summary: Frontend-only testing of StudyLocus dashboard Reset Layout, dense auto-pack, min/max size constraints, and regression flows. All 4 primary acceptance criteria pass. Admin login works, and layout changes persist across reload.

issues: Uses browser default date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a themed/shadcn date picker — pre-existing carryover.

console_warnings.warning: react-grid-layout: 'prop minHeight larger than item height/maxHeight'
console_warnings.cause: Collapsing a card sets h=2 while the item still carries minH from CARD_META (e.g., minH=4). Functionally harmless (collapse still works and height renders at 78px) but produces a React console error on every collapse. Suggested fix: when collapsing, also temporarily set minH:1 (and restore original minH on expand), or drop minH when h<minH in collapsed set.

test_results.T2_reset_layout: PASS - After reset, exactly the 8 default cards render with default sizes (countdown 432x222, journey 882x222, tasks 432x414, studylog 432x558, welcome 432x222, quote 432x318, mock 432x750, planner 432x366).
test_results.T2b_reset_persists_reload: PASS - Reload restores the same 8 default cards from server settings.
test_results.T3_dense_pack_after_delete: PASS - Deleting Countdown (top-left) caused Journey to move from (468,18) → (18,18); no persistent horizontal hole remains.
test_results.T4_min_size_enforced: PASS - Dragging Welcome's react-resizable-handle strongly toward top-left produced final size 320x126 (~3 cols × 3 rows = minW/minH). Card content remains usable.
test_results.T5_max_width_cap: PASS - Repeatedly clicking card-resize-btn on Countdown cycled widths 432↔657 only (steps 4 and 6), never exceeding maxW=6.
test_results.T6_drag_via_drag_handle: PASS - Dragging Welcome via .drag-handle moved from x=918 → x=18 in the same row.
test_results.T8_add_card_menu: PASS - add-card-btn → add-pomodoro adds Pomodoro to grid.
test_results.T9_quote_rotate: PASS - New Quote button changes quote text.
test_results.T10_add_task: PASS - New task appears in My Tasks list.

action_items: (Optional/Minor) Suppress the react-grid-layout 'minHeight larger than height/maxHeight' console error by relaxing minH on the collapsed card in toggleCollapse (e.g., set minH:1 while collapsed and restore on expand).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is ~390 lines and still comfortable; CARD_META + packDense + applyConstraints are cleanly separated.
packDense is O(W*H*N) with a hard-coded outer loop y<1000 — fine for current 12 cards but consider bounding by sum of heights.
resetLayout closes SettingsModal but does NOT save any other in-modal edits (theme/subjects/exam). Acceptable but worth noting — user must click Save Changes separately for those.
commit()'s persistLayout is debounced 600ms; rapid interactions can drop the trailing save if user reloads within debounce window (not observed in this run — reload after 2s+ succeeded).
seed_data_creation: Added a couple of TEST_ prefixed tasks during regression; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset Layout and dense auto-pack behavior are verified end-to-end. Only lingering issue is a non-blocking react-grid-layout console warning fired on card collapse due to minH staying > h=2. Base URL from frontend/.env; token localStorage 'sl_token'.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking bugs. Console warning RCA: on collapse the card's layout item retains minH (e.g., 4) but h is forced to 2; RGL logs 'prop minHeight larger than item height/maxHeight'. Fix by clearing/lowering minH on collapse and restoring on expand.
